title: NodeBench redesign chat sprints 1-4 closed-loop handoff

problem.previousState: The first recorded walkthrough rendered all 11 chat features but skipped three dependency-bound behaviors and left several end-state actions unasserted.
problem.painOrRisk: A reviewer could see controls in a video without evidence that hover, restore, unpin, modal selection, clipboard determinism, and correction completion actually closed their loops.

decision.selectedApproach: Add a deterministic fresh-chat seed, close the missing interaction paths in the recorder, and bind every material demo claim to the archived assertion map, scene log, and media artifacts.
alternatives: Keep the v1 video and describe the skipped paths in prose
Treat render-only checks as equivalent to completed interactions
tradeoffs: The fresh-chat seed is a deterministic demonstration path rather than evidence about every live data state
The archived run proves its recorded revision and date, not current production behavior

proofRequirements: Every archived boolean assertion is true
The scene timeline and video artifacts resolve to immutable content hashes
Material claims resolve to evidence IDs
Historical and current-production scope remain visibly separated
approvalBoundaries: No deployment is performed by the adapter
No package publication is performed by the adapter
A NodeSlide proposal or export requires a separate host-approved step

claims.text: The archived v2 recorder result contains 26 of 26 passing boolean assertions across the 11 chat feature groups.
limitations: This is evidence for the archived run, not a fresh production replay.

claims.text: Two consecutive Share actions in the archived run produced the same reproducibility hash.
limitations: The assertion covers the recorded AnswerPacket fixture, not all possible packet inputs.

claims.text: The v2 handoff records completed hover, counterfactual probe, restore, unpin, modal-selection, clipboard, and correction end states that were skipped or render-only in v1.
limitations: The comparison is based on the archived v1 and v2 handoff artifacts.

evidence.summary: Original NodeBench redesign submission summary, affected surfaces, verification commands, and historical deployment blocker.
Human-readable v1-to-v2 comparison, reproduction command, per-PR lineage, and closed-loop checklist.
Machine-readable boolean assertion map captured by the v2 Playwright recorder.
Timestamped scene sequence for navigation, interactions, end states, and final hold.
Archived H.264 walkthrough of the v2 interaction sequence.
Archived reviewer-friendly GIF derived from the v2 walkthrough.
Historical deployment, frontend, backend, database, agent, and QA data-flow diagram.
Per-surface lineage for the four chat enhancement sprints and their source commits.

before: A v1 demo showed all feature groups but left dependency-bound interactions skipped or only mid-flow
Claims, evidence files, and limitations were linked through prose rather than a machine-readable evidence index
Presentation consumers had to rediscover the story from markdown and filenames
after: A deterministic handoff envelope binds scoped claims to assertion, trace, media, architecture, and changelog evidence
The local adapter verifies boolean assertions and hashes every repository artifact before export
NodeKit Present receives canonical Change Story, claims, Evidence Index, architecture diff, limitations, and a deterministic receipt
NodeSlide proposal, editing, and export remain separate governed transports

limitations: The evidence was recorded on 2026-05-07 and does not establish current production behavior.
The adapter verifies archived artifacts and boolean assertions but does not replay Playwright or invoke a visual judge.
No NodeSlide deck proposal, editable deck, PPTX export, or reopen verification is produced in this P1 slice.
No authentication, deployment, package publication, paid activation, or destructive action is in scope.
nextMilestone: Let an installed NodeSlide transport consume this evidence-bound Change Story and propose a Tier 2 deck without changing the handoff source of truth.
